This is only a minor edit of Emily's game sprite, a friend asked me to create a slightly curvier Emily. She has a Slight bust increase on this sprite, I didn't bother with the extreme over the shoulder boulder holder look. A character having a boob big as her head is a bit too much for me (but if you want a big tiddie Stardew waifu, I'll add it in .... :D ....) I do plan on creating custom icons that I want for her character & maybe a few others, may possibly add them up on Nexus here some time. I usually make sprite icons for Byond games, so this is my 1st edit for Nexus.
